profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Laserfiche | Computer Science Degree
profile.summary: Software engineer specializing in robust cloud solutions, reliable backend systems, and full-stack development across the complete software lifecycle. Experienced in AWS cloud architecture, Kubernetes and Docker microservices, Azure DevOps deployment pipelines, and Angular and JavaScript applications, with a broader foundation in Java, .NET, and embedded and enterprise software. I improve product reliability and delivery efficiency through release automation, test development, production diagnostics, and close cross-functional coordination. I bring analytical problem-solving, creativity, and continuous learning to building software that addresses complex customer needs.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
•	Developed and deployed microservices in Kubernetes and Docker to support efficient, reliable operations.
•	Usage of AWS CloudFormation, Amazon S3, Route 53, and Amazon RDS to deliver cloud products.
•	Implemented and automated deployment pipelines through Azure DevOps.
•	Use Claude AI Agent to support test authoring and pipeline automation. In addition, usage of AI agent to help troubleshoot and diagnose issues using data from Kibana logs, Grafana dashboards, and memory dumps.
•      Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions with organization-wide dependencies, coordinating implementation timelines and synchronizing deployments to ensure smooth, reliable releases.

positions.title: Technical Program Manager II
positions.description:
Led team to align product objectives with the overall vision for Cloud solutions, resulting in high-quality software delivery on a continuous basis.

• Managed product backlogs, prioritized work items, and facilitated sprints and releases to deliver on release objectives.
• Created and maintained metrics dashboards to report on product team feature and product success.
• Ensured the product team addressed all support and quality issues in a timely manner to prioritize customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Scrum Master
positions.description:
• Led Agile events/ceremonies to deliver business value and foster continuous improvement.
• Identified and removed impediments hindering team's sprint goal achievement.
• Provided resources and communication to enable team to deliver working software with desired capabilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Successfully developed and deployed Cloud Solutions using Amazon web services, created build and release cloud pipelines using Azure, troubleshooted customer issues, and gained valuable experience in Mob programming.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Achievement Highlights:

* Launched Samsung SyncThru Admin 6 - Lead client side engineer for SyncThru Admin 6 which is a printer fleet management solution that helps organizations increase their efficiency and productivity. Responsibilities included design of Portal to enable different plugins to contribute to UI, definition of different extension / customization points within UI, and implementation of client side framework that enabled Portal Integration pattern. Design enabled sales organizations to win bids due to ability to easily extend and customize UI.
Technologies used: OSGi, Spring framework 2.x and 3.x, Spring Security, Adobe Flex, BlazeDS, Java, ActionScript 3.0, JavaScript, , XML, HTML and Eclipse IDE.

* Amazon Dash – Samsung Toner Replenishment Service- Lead engineer for channel list integration with Dash services, Dash API validation and Samsung mobile print app (Android). Primary liaison with Amazon for resolving integration issues. Successfully lead collaboration from inception to validation and final Samsung Certification for Dash program. Planned launch date 1st quarter 2016. 
Technologies used: Amazon SNS, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, Android, JavaScript, HTML, JSP, Java, REST, Eclipse, Tomcat, Spring Framework, Jersey, JAX- RS.

* Embedded Smart Agent – Lead engineer for embedded Agent running on Samsung’s eXtensible Open Architecture (XOA). Agent was responsible for performing device management functions within customer network environment (firewall). Agent exposed set of RESTful management API(s) that were made accessible through XMPP or SQS and enabled clients to perform remote operations on Agent. Agent was successfully used as part of Pilot and is currently in productization path to be incorporated within Samsung solutions. 
Technologies used: Samsung XOA-Web, JavaScript, HTML, Java, Eclipse, OSGI, Spring DM

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Achievement Highlights:

* Samsung Cloud Services JS API– Lead engineer for developing JavaScript API that may be used by clients for communicating with Samsung Cloud Services. Purpose of API was to enable clients to quickly integrate with Samsung Cloud Services by abstracting them from security requirements of system, provide error handling capabilities, control client experience, and backward compatibility testing. API was incorporated by Browser and Mobile clients and teams reported higher productivity due to ease of use of API.

Technologies used: Android, REST, JavaScript, Java, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon S3, JavaScript, HTML, JSP

* Launched Samsung SmarThru Workflow (version 1)– Lead engineer for Samsung SmarThru Workflow 1 which is a server-based document workflow solution that helps streamline document capture, processing, routing, indexing and storage. Responsibilities included design of folder monitoring, workform concatenation and execution, as well as designing and implementing a dynamic web client with drag-and-drop capabilities. Communicated design and development with High Level Design and Low Level Design documents. The design enabled sales organizations to win bids due to its easy to create and execute workflow features.

Technologies used: .NET, VB.NET, C#, ASP.NET and JavaScript, and Clearcase

* Embedded Web Services for Multi-Function printing devices – Lead engineer in researching printer accounting requirements such as collection of counters and designing an embedded web service to collect and make them available outside the printer for further data aggregation as part of an embedded web services platform.

Technologies used: OSGI, REST-ful web services, JAVA, Java Servlet

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Achievement Highlights:

* Liaison and Lead for third party vendors and my team for Software Localization effort. Worked on code design for Digital Sending software that goes in Multi-Function printing devices using C, C++ and MFC. I was also responsible for creation of software installers for current products using InstallShield technology and also administrate software build process using Windows Clearcase.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Constructed a CD Browser from a Netscape based Web Browser for printer installers with the capability to launch executable files without asking the client to save them locally before launching them. Added the browser easy localization capability by adding language support for twenty-seven languages and easy HTML/JavaScript page design and navigation. CD Browser for installers was modified using C++ , MFC and various scripting tools.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Created an information channel for portable devices (PDAs), such as Palm Pilots and Windows CE devices that would synchronize their information whenever they were synced through the implementation of a client/server software, middleware and the use of Korn Scripting, JavaScript & HTML, in an NT and Linux mixed environment.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Assisted in updating the website for Advanced Manufacturing Engineering using HTML and various graphic arts software. Supported work in the CAD/Cam Conversion Lab.

patents.title: Platform system with provider controlling mechanism and method of operation thereof
patents.description: A method of operation of a provider controlling platform system includes: determining a provider criterion for selecting a service provider; determining a device capability for selecting a device service for a peripheral device; generating a selection threshold based on the provider criterion, the device capability, or a combination thereof for executing the device service; and generating a service command based on the selection threshold meeting or exceeding a service request for commanding the peripheral device to execute the device service.

patents.title: System and method for embedded load balancing in a multifunction peripheral (MFP)
patents.description: The invention relates to multifunction peripherals (MFPs). More particularly, the invention relates to an embedded load balancer in a multifunction peripheral. An MFP with an embedded load balancer may determine that another suitable device is more capable of handling a job request, and, subsequently, may transfer the job request to the other device.
